title: ‘Have Faith in God, but Get Out of Atlanta’
summary: Pastor Daniel Whyte III urges the homeless of Atlanta to keep their faith in God — and to leave the city for a better life.
body_html:
Pastor Daniel Whyte III shared this word during his October 9 sermon, 'Prayer, Love, and Advice for the 144,000 Homeless People in Atlanta.' Watch the full sermon here: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158.

“Have faith in God, but get out of Atlanta.”

— Daniel Whyte III

Watch the full sermon: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158
takeaway: “Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.” (Proverbs 3:5-6, KJV)
